title: cv_list
description: Controlled vocabularies referenced by the archive. Stored in the file-level metadata of the mzPeak archive (FileIndex.metadata.cv_list), analogous to mzML's <cvList>. Every CV code referenced by any column name or parameters entry MUST be declared here so a reader can resolve every accession to a declared, versioned ontology URI (spec Edit 2, CVL-01).

id.description: CV code, e.g. MS, UO, IMS
